thread.title: Pandora Media ( P ) is the largest personalized music delive

author: Nealster
title: Pandora Media ( P ) is the largest personalized music delive
text:
Pandora Media ( P ) is the largest personalized music delivery service in the United States. It is predominantly known for its mobile app that features ad-supported radio stations based on each listener's music preference. Shares of Pandora are set for significant price appreciation from current levels because 1) The advertising revenue opportunity in front of Pandora is large, 2) The stock has been beaten down and is cheap while having durable competitive advantages, and 3) new management installed by Sirius XM ( SIRI ) and John Malone's Liberty Media (NASDAQ: FWONA ) are the catalysts required to simplify the business and focus on capturing Pandora's advertising revenue potential and cutting costs.
Large Advertising Opportunity Before getting to the numbers, let's zoom out to the big opportunity. The transition from traditional media advertising (TV, Radio, Newspapers) to the internet giants [Google ( GOOG ) (NASDAQ: GOOGL ) and Facebook ( FB )] has been one of the biggest stories of the internet economy. Google has a market cap over $700 billion and Facebook has a market cap over $500 billion almost exclusively due to revenues associated with internet advertising. If we look at the two charts below, we can see that Pandora is in the ballpark of Google and Facebook when we look at the number of active app users and the amount of time each user spends with the app. The only companies on these charts not owned by Google and Facebook are Snapchat ( SNAP ) ($23 Bil Market Cap), Pandora ($1.2 Bil Market Cap), Spotify (estimated private market valuation of $20 Bil), and Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) ($800 Bil). Pandora is truly tiny in market value compared to the internet advertising behemoths.
